title: Stamina and Weight
description: A configurable survival mod with two main mechanics: stamina and weight. Stamina affects movement and combat, while weight changes how equipment and items impact gameplay. Most features can be balanced through config files.
body: A configurable survival mod with two main mechanics: stamina and weight. Stamina affects movement and combat, while weight changes how equipment and items impact gameplay. Most features can be balanced through config files. Specific parameters can also be decreased or adjusted using the /saw command.
